import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    x = feats.x
    y = feats.y
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(x.T)
    
    # Identify near-duplicates (|r| >= 0.6)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(ids[j])
    
    # Filter out near-duplicates
    keep_idx = [i for i in range(len(ids)) if ids[i] not in to_remove]
    keep_ids = [ids[i] for i in keep_idx]
    keep_x = x[:, keep_idx]
    
    # Compute effect sizes (mean difference)
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(keep_ids):
        idx1 = y == 1
        idx0 = y == 0
        mean_diff = np.mean(keep_x[idx1, i]) - np.mean(keep_x[idx0, i])
        effect_sizes.append(abs(mean_diff))
    
    # Select top features by effect size
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1][:min(MAX_DRIVERS, len(keep_ids))]
    selected_ids = [keep_ids[i] for i in sorted_indices]
    
    # Check if any features have strong effect
    if max(effect_sizes) < 0.1:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Select features for regression
    columns = tuple(selected_ids)
    
    # Compute mutual information to guide product terms
    mi_scores = mutual_info_classif(keep_x[:, sorted_indices], y)
    
    # Add interaction terms for top features
    products = []
    for i in range(len(sorted_indices)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(sorted_indices)):
            if mi_scores[i] > 0.05 and mi_scores[j] > 0.05:
                products.append((selected_ids[i], selected_ids[j]))
    
    # Weighted score using top features
    loadings = dict(zip(selected_ids, [1.0]*len(selected_ids)))
    
    # Drivers are the most effective features
    drivers = tuple(selected_ids)
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
